posts.text:
Graham Platner is an absolutely terrible human being. It’s good that he’s going to drop out.

However, why has the House Ethics Committee sat on reports about other members of Congress who are currently seeking reelection? Don’t you think the same standard of conduct should apply to both Democrats and Republicans alike?
posts.summary: Criticizes ethics committee double standard between parties

posts.text:
On the 250th birthday of the United States, our President called to pass the SAVE America Act to require proof of citizenship to vote in our elections. This is something over 80% of Americans want. 

The House has now passed it THREE TIMES and each time we pass it to the Senate they FAIL.

The people want it. The House wants it. The President wants it.

@leaderthune is claiming it’s a numbers problem. I think it’s evident it’s a leadership problem.
posts.summary: Backs voter citizenship requirement, criticizes Senate inaction
